description: This file defines an interface ITaskRepository for task data management, including methods for CRUD operations and retrieval based on user ID.

classes.name: ITaskRepository
classes.description: Repository abstraction interface for TaskItem entity, providing asynchronous methods for task retrieval, addition, update, and deletion.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a TaskItem by its unique identifier asynchronously.

methods.name: GetAllForUserAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all TaskItem records associated with a specific user asynchronously.
